notes.title: Easy Climb Update
notes.content:
[h1]Price Drop[/h1]
Time Transit will now be more accessible for everybody with a PERMANENT price change! You can get it now for 19,99$ !

[h1]Easy Climb Mode[/h1]
Last Update we focused on ground locomotion. This time we improved climbing and added a new easy mode. If you have been frustrated with missing jumps and having to re-climb a long section you can now enable respawning from where you fell instead of where you started climbing.

[h1]Legacy Input for Vive[/h1]
In the last update we introduced new locomotion and quite a few changes to the existing teleportation. Especially the controls for HTC Vive changed quite a bit. If you liked the pre-patch controls better you can now enable the "Legacy" option.

[h1]Fixes[/h1]
Updated the FMOD version so CPUs without AVX can play sound. Thanks to ianl for reporting and testing!

Sometimes the rotating bridge puzzle wasn't locking in correctly making it difficult to progress. Thanks to Michael Bright for reporting this!

notes.title: Summer Sale & Smooth Locomotion Update
notes.content:
[h1]The Summer Sale is here and we are proud to announce our first big update!
[/h1]
We've really enjoyed watching people play our game, and seeing all your wonderful reactions to it. We're constantly trying to think of ways to make it better, but more importantly, we really want to make sure the game is accessible to all of you who have shown interest. One of the most important things for us is to make sure Time Transit VR gets into the hands of the people we think will love it as much as we do.


[h1]Smooth Locomotion[/h1]
A lot of you told us they didn't like the teleportation only movement because it broke immersion. We want everyone to enjoy our game, so we went back and overhauled our entire movement interface. Teleport, dash teleport, controller or head based smooth locomotion, teleport turning, snap turning and smooth turning, you can now set your preferred method in the options.

In addition to that, we also added more comfort options that should help with motion sickness. Everything can be mixed and matched to suit your preferred play style.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34259024/54297555d31cee55485a195a83453df62048289b.jpg[/img]

[h1]More Dinosaurs[/h1]
Our levels are more lively than ever! Six new dinosaur species have appeared in the jungle. Can you find them all? We’d love to see your photos!
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34259024/a5f38e4795032b02ddb121ef12617cb0fb97e3ed.png[/img]

Thanks for your support and have fun!
The Time Transit Team
